actionability: A concrete engineering verb and a specific stated behavior/capability/contract, not a bare domain or identifier. Ambiguous implementation/mechanical intent rejects rather than opening a semantic patch.
deduplication: Identical normalized task text and explicit work-item identity when present; lexicographically smallest child SHA representative. Semantically identical assignments may be listed explicitly with rationale before selection, never based on retrieval evidence.
exclusions: previous development or held-out episode identity
holdout: Mechanical patch bytes may be hashed without decoding/semantic inspection before selection. Replay consumes captured digest envelopes and never reopens a selected child's paths/patch after selection.
production_requirement: At least one src/devtools/ source file; accompanying tests/docs/config permitted
public_surface: Exact task text/source hashes and parent commit/tree only. No child identity, changed-path data, semantic patch, gold or ranking in selected task surface.
scope_expansion: Only if fewer than 8 eligible episodes in preferred scope, expand once to all first-parent history through starting HEAD under identical rules. No intermediate windows.
selection: Target16; eligible8..15 chooseall; below8 stop. Seed = SHA256(canonical JSON array of domain, startingHEAD, historyScopeDigest, originalFreezeDigest, expandedFreezeDigest, eligibleInventoryDigest). Keys = SHA256(seed raw bytes + UTF8 candidateID), sort raw bytes then candidateID; firstN; no reroll.
size_rationale: Pre-anchor aggregate production episodes have median 9 total files/3 production files/413 production-test lines, p90 23 files/10 production files/1723 lines. Rounded engineering-scale ceilings admit bounded work while excluding giant migrations; fixed before task metadata review.
task_authority: Exact original subject plus body, no synthetic rewriting. Commit-message-only mode; parent-work-item augmentation is not used in this extension.
traversal: first-parent, newest to oldest, reachable from starting HEAD; exactly one parent required
